title: Country Music Themed Condo Steps from Music Row
description:
The ultimate photo worthy getaway for your Nashville vacation. Enjoy a newly renovated spacious 2 bedroom 1 bath condo filled with tons of music inspired personality. Featuring a full kitchen and washer and dryer in the unit. Parking is easy and complimentary. Walk to any midtown bar or restaurant or take a quick Uber ride to the Honky Tonks, Bridgestone Arena, and Nissan Stadium. There are very few places that are more centrally located to everything Nashville has to offer!
